nom: Neutrogena Blackhead Eliminating Facial Scrub With Purifying Salicylic Acid

avis.titre: Better as a general face scrub
avis.texte: I have lots of black heads and bought this hoping it would help get rid of and prevent them. It uh, doesn’t really do that. But it does make your skin very smooth so that’s nice atleast.

avis.titre: Really works, even in hot humid conditions
avis.texte: Excellent. I’ve tried several brands but this is the one that works. Surprisingly, it doesn’t leave my skin dry and irritated like other brands.
This is my wife’s favorite facial cleanser. She claims it doesn’t dry out her skin and it leaves her skin feeling soft.
It's so easy to use and does a great job. I'm an older lady and wasn't sure how it would work but I was pleasantly surprised. It started helping with the blackheads and only a few days!
A fantastic facial scrub. I use it before shaving and it helix make a smooth, close shave possible and easier. Skin also feels great after use!
Efficacité moyenne, peau plus douce mais ne desincruste pas les pores

avis.titre: Great and good valueGreat and good value
avis.texte: I used it once and I already noticed some slight improvement especially on my nose which was super surprising. Obviously the smoothing effect will take longer (4 weeks plus) since the salicylic acid does this by speeding up cell turnover but right now I’m really happy with the product. I was a bit worried it would irritate my skin since I have combination skin which is slightly sensitive so I did some test patches and I’m happy to say it did not irritate! No extra redness whatsoever. But redness and irritation is still a risk as it is a scrub so remember to test. Smells really nice and fresh (kind of like sunscreen) but no fragrance so that’s a plus. I thought the price was quite good since most branded products containing active ingredients usually cost more.
Surprisingly, yes it does work and works well for those with oily skin and whiteheads. A well worthwhile purchase.
